component: Account Hub incoming protocol OAuth refresh

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: This landing calls the existing OAuth visibility helper in the protocol-change handler after updating config/port state. The new task switches IMAP→EWS→Graph and checks each authentication popup with the shared hidden-flag helper. With the customization preference enabled, that helper's production counterpart offers OAuth for an Exchange config; Graph also needs its feature preference. This tests option state in source, not authentication. The later accepted task's OAuth-selection/IMAP-reset assertions are a separate phase, and the reused shared assertion diagnostic remains inverted.
title: Changing the manual protocol recomputes the OAuth option without another hostname edit
